# CANDIDATE: AFTERNOON_LEVEL_RETEST_WITH_EMA_STACK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An afternoon retest of a prior named level (prior day high, low, VWAP, or weekly pivot) that aligns with a bullish EMA stack (8>21>34>55) offers a high-probability continuation long. The edge exists because afternoon retests often attract liquidity as traders defend prior session levels, and a bullish EMA stack indicates underlying upward momentum, increasing the probability of a sustained move after the retest.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: Select a named level from the prior session (prior day high, low, VWAP, or weekly pivot). When price approaches within 0.1% of that level between 12:00 and 14:00 EST, and the EMA stack is bullish (8 EMA > 21 EMA > 34 EMA > 55 EMA) with the price closing above the level on increased volume (>1.3× average volume), enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Stop below the named level (or below the 8 EMA if tighter); target 2R; then trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR(3)×2).
